author: alexki
quote:
Absoute dog ****.
This game is not a GTA game, and if it was called anything else than GTA, it would have been slammed by critics and everyone else who is just coping extremely hard right now.
GTA 5 had interesting characters all over the story line, GTA 6 has no interesting characters at all.
The most entertaining ones are the random NPC events.
Everything is wrong with this game.
80% of this **** is just walking around, talking with people with the personality of a brick, doing chores and sometimes do a stupid mission that lacks meaning, a good story behind it, and good characters.

Woke bs chore simulator for soft men, do not buy!
